task.title: Native daily-driver performance Phase 2: baseline and diagnostic (report 1 of 3)

result.summary: Baseline measured on production data with a zero-write in-container benchmark of the exact Native read service plus today's Founder production read diagnostics and CPU profiles. No common path is SEVERE/CRITICAL; historical ~10s Priority navigation, 7.6-10s Training Library and Visible Abs 503 did not reproduce. Ranked bottlenecks: Home cold launch (2-3s spinner; ~4.8s after restart; ~0.55s of Home CPU is Intl formatter construction), Priority Detail completion acknowledgement waiting on a full Home read, Training Logger 1.7-2.9s CPU in exercise-phrase normalization, resume burst on a 5-connection pool, ~3.2MB mostly-undecoded Evidence Hub payload. Limits: no Founder-device operation; Native end-to-end numbers are composed from measured Server time, measured network overhead and the source request graph.

tests.summary: Baseline/diagnostic report; tests are reported with the candidate.

zero_write_audit.summary: Benchmark ran in a READ ONLY transaction with a SELECT/WITH-only statement guard and ROLLBACK; logs read-only.

unexpected_findings: Priority Detail completion awaits a full canonical Home read before acknowledging.
Home read twice at cold launch in production logs (cause unproven without a device trace).
backlog: Candidate implementation and before/after acceptance reports follow.
recommended_next_step: Review the implementation candidate report when published.
